ev.q: At the end of the survey period, 44 (83%) of the 53 newborn screening programs responded to the survey.
Twenty-five (57%) programs reported use of two modalities
The Hb Bart’s cutoff percentage used for classifying alpha-thalassemia types varied widely among programs

methods_quotes.q: An eight-question survey was e-mailed to all 53 U.S. newborn screening programs.
Nonrespondents received reminder e-mails and telephone calls in an effort to maximize the response rate.
Categories are not mutually exclusive; newborn screening programs report multiple results.
